review: Read-only independent review by shower-chair builder plus root source/visual/scorer audit

findings.detail: Full score now requires60 consecutive control steps satisfying every final condition; rawscore/success are pure and agree.
Exposure and release sample24 distal finger points; do not claim whole hand/arm coverage.
Handle/ring engagement uses geometric position-dependent joint limits; hose two-link model, spring and friction are engineering estimates.

Manufacturer B-0107-J drawing shows pivot near nozzle, handle free end toward hose and plain hold-down ring. Prototype reverses lever/free-end orientation and adds14x19mm thumbtab, altering direction/contact access. Earlier audit lacked primary geometry comparison. Independent reviewer agrees this is material.

visual: First final-source demo shows visible flow, contact-driven release, no stream at end and grippers clear. Idle and squeeze-only remain on.
next: Rebuild an identified real valve with matching dimensions/access, then repeat final validation and model trial; or abandon.
lesson: Match actual defining mechanism/access before simulation. A high demo score cannot establish representative hardware.
